title: The XZ Backdoor: A Nightmare That Shook the Open-Source World (Retrospective on CVE-2024-3094)
content_md:
The XZ Backdoor: A Nightmare That Shook the Open-Source World. In late March 2024, the tech world held its breath. A Microsoft developer discovered a sophisticated backdoor in the XZ Utils compression library, CVE-2024-3094. The backdoor, inserted through a years-long social engineering campaign by a contributor using the pseudonym Jia Tan, targeted the OpenSSH authentication mechanism on Linux systems. If successfully deployed, it would have given remote attackers unauthenticated root access to affected systems.

via Mastodon https://dev.to/uhltak/die-xz-backdoor-weckruf-fur-die-open-source
